releases.summary: Tabs that do more, on the web and the Mac: pin tabs, see a tab's page before you open it, see every tab at once, and work on up to three notes side by side.
added: Pinned tabs: pin a tab from its pin or its menu; it stays at the start of the strip, half as wide, and closing other tabs keeps it.
Tab previews: rest on a tab to see a picture of its page, then move along the strip to see the others at once.
Tab Overview: every open tab as a picture, with search, close and a new note (the grid button, or Shift-Command-\).
Joined notes: up to three notes side by side in one tab, resized with snapping, rearranged by their bars, folded into slim spines on narrow windows.
Mac: editor text in five sizes, from Smaller to Larger.
improved: Home is a single house icon at the start of the tabs.
Tabs keep the same width whether they're open or not.
Mac: the tab strip is glass over the page, with thin scroll bars that show only while scrolling.
Mac: Settings is redesigned, with Folevi's own icons, each pane as tall as it needs and the version shown once.
Mac: Vault passwords show the list and the open item side by side on wide windows.
Tooltips are Folevi's own everywhere and never repeat what a button already says.
Mac: Focus Mode is now Option-Command-\ (Shift-Command-\ shows all tabs).

releases.summary: Mac tab strip and note card polish.
improved: Mac tab strip: Home is pinned after Back and Forward, and only the tabs after it scroll
Mac tab strip: New note sits as far from the right edge as the Back arrow from the left
fixed: Note cards: the shadow animates with the card, so no pale band shows under a card as the hover ends

releases.summary: The Mac tab strip matches the web's, and the Vault unlocks encryption in place.
improved: Mac tab strip matches the web's: only the tabs scroll, New note 4 pt from the edge
The Vault unlocks encryption in place: one card, the ways to unlock, then the passcode (web and Mac)

releases.summary: The Mac window and account button follow the web, and the note card star moves to the cover's corner.
improved: Mac: the window follows the place's Settings > Appearance, as its page does
Note cards: the star's tab sits in the cover's corner, as on the web
Mac: the account button shows the profile picture or the workspace's logo, as on the web

releases.summary: Mac tabs open, close and reorder as on the web.
improved: Mac tabs: the whole tab opens it, a middle-click closes it, and tabs drag to reorder, as on the web

releases.summary: Folevi for Mac rebuilt as a native app that matches the web.
added: Folevi for Mac rebuilt as a native app that matches the web: the window frame, sidebar, top bar, tabs and menus drawn natively from the web's styles
Native Home, note lists, folders, Tasks, Calendar, Search, Notifications, Settings, sharing, invitations and Quick Add on the Mac
Every screen before the app (first launch, library setup, sign-in, offline, the Touch ID cover) native on the Mac
Notes dragged from the Mac's lists to Finder go as Markdown files
Decline a workspace or page invitation
improved: Foli AI chat streams within its frame budget
Editor text size applies on every page
iPhone: 120 Hz on ProMotion iPhones and Folevi's own web view host instead of Capacitor

releases.summary: The Vault, folder sharing on the web, and security hardening.
added: The Vault: passwords and credentials, Files & Notes, people and roles, sharing items and one-time secret links, Health, notifications, item history, import and export
Folder sharing on the web: Share in the folder menu and toolbar, shared folder and invitation pages, Shared with Me
improved: A folder page shows its subfolders as folder cards
The Ask Foli AI flower blooms now and then and while Foli AI works
Security: patched libraries, Foli AI can't be steered into sending data out, a daily encrypted backup, sessions end after a password reset
iPhone: sheets reach the screen's bottom edge, and a themed note's cover band has rounded corners

releases.summary: Every note kept on the device.
added: Every note kept on the device: background fill, instant opening, prefetch on intent, attachments, encrypted copies sealed at rest
improved: A faster device copy feed from the server

releases.summary: Foli AI for long notes, offline notes everywhere, and faster iPhone and iPad apps.
added: Foli AI handles long notes: an outline, paged reading, batched edits and Continue
improved: Foli AI's Ask chat fills the note's panel, with the composer at the bottom
Notes written offline show at once everywhere and reach the server after reconnecting
iPhone and iPad: faster taps and typing, a note zooms out of its card and back, sheets slide in from below, a sync status for touch
The apps open the last-known folio at once, and their first screen loads 14 % less code
fixed: folevi.com opens your notes even without the signed-in hint cookie

releases.summary: Faster sign-in with Google or Apple in the apps.
improved: Sign-in in the apps: Continue with Google or Apple goes straight to that provider's page

releases.summary: Folevi for Mac is native only, uses less memory, and folders drag and drop.
added: Sidebar folders: drag and drop for notes and folders (web, Mac, iPad)
improved: Folevi for Mac is the native app only, downloaded from folevi.com and updated by Sparkle
Mac memory: background places, Quick Add and hidden windows let go of what they don't need, and memory warnings are answered
The account menu: places first, the rest in Settings
First launch: Sign in to Folevi is the suggested choice
fixed: Flowchart connectors: Reverse direction turns the arrow, and lines between close shapes stay straight

releases.summary: One version for every platform, and the first native Folevi for Mac.
added: One version for every platform: the web, Folevi for Mac, iPhone and iPad and Android all show Folevi 1.0.00, never a build number
The first native Folevi for Mac release
